meta.purpose: Closes the self-improvement loop. Cron lists applied improvement_proposals due for outcome review and calls fn_record_proposal_outcome (two-phase: baseline -> outcome). On regression the RPC PROPOSES a gated rollback (advisory-only). Observer never executes.
